newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Red October 96 pre-tax falls to 168 bn rbls.
newsitem.headline: Russia Red October 96 pre-tax falls to 168 bn rbls.

text.p: Pre-tax profit 168 bln rbls 185.04 bln rbls
Net profit 127.76 bln rbls 136.49 bln rbls
NOTE - Full company name is OAO Konditerskaya Fabrika Krasny Octyabr.
Dividends per ordinary share with a face value of 1,000 roubles.
Financial results, with the exception of production volume, are not consolidated, only cover Red October parent company.

These figures are not prepared to international accounting standards but to cash-based Russian accounting standards, which differ significantly from those normally supplied in the West. Russian accounts are designed to meet the requirements of the tax authorities. Definitions of profit and assets differ significantly from those in the West, and converting Russian accounts to international standards can turn a profit into a loss.
Figures are not adjusted for inflation or the depreciation of the rouble, but the following data may be helpful.
Dollar on Moscow Interbank Currency Exchange (MICEX):
Year-on-year consumer price inflation rate in December 1996 was 21.8 percent in December 1996 after 131 percent in December 1995 and 215 percent in December 1994 and 840 percent in December 1993.
Figures audited by Grant-Audit. Coopers & Lybrand is currently restating the Russian accounts to international standards and conducting an audit to international standards.
